title: TENANT-X global tenant-isolation PASS is not maintained after certification: its drift gate is pinned to the historical SHA and later tenant-bearing changes include an open untenanted-registry path
affected_invariant: FRZ-TEN-10 (missing tenant is rejected, never defaulted); roadmap tenant isolation invariant
evidence: E1:commit de384336d (TASK memory tenant gap, EQOA-A3-012) and 817d41db1 (carrier re-pin 819->831)
impact: TENANT-X FINAL was accepted at 5ccb72fc (2026-10-12) with FRZ-TEN-01..12 = PASS. Since then 121 non-test product files touching tenant identifiers changed. The stage production-delta gate is deliberately limited to 940e6219..5ccb72fc, so it cannot flag any of them; independent audits found real gaps (TASK memory: fixed; G-09 untenanted evaluation registry with tenant None in strict hosts: still in code at baseline). A global PASS that no executable gate can falsify is a standing risk for the tenant isolation entry condition of the freeze.
recommendation: Requalify TENANT-X delta-scoped: review the tenant-bearing diff since 5ccb72fc by carrier family, close G-09 (fail closed on tenant None in strict hosts, or record an explicit exception), and replace the pinned production-delta gate by one that runs against the freeze SHA.

title: STATE-X and TRACE-X closed-world gates were not executed after the 2026-10-30 replay although 274 product files changed (70 added, 204 modified), including new durable stores and a new MCP ingress
affected_invariant: Closed-world durable-state discovery (STATE-X) and closed-world production composition parity (TRACE-X)
impact: Both stages certify closed-world coverage (AST discovery, registry parity). The replay passed at 22fbc0e; afterwards PDC added durable scheduler/recurrence rows, a sqlite artifact store and the MCP server ingress. Owners edited the STATE-X classification for the artifact store, which shows maintenance, but no retained log shows either suite executed since. Whether the gates still pass is unknown.
recommendation: Campaign B: one bounded pytest run of the two named nodes (AST-only, no services); widen to the full stage directories only if a node fails.

title: Closed-world counters of TENANT-X and COMPAT-X were re-pinned after certification by the implementer (T-IGX-041-I, T-IGX-041-L) without an independent re-execution
impact: Both re-pins were done under the P7 repair scope with id-exact delta checks, a SHA-256 digest of the added ids and negative tests, so the gates stayed mechanical. The residual is that each re-pin certifies its own delta; the first independent run of the re-pinned gates is pending (IA-D6 saw tenant_x red before the re-pin, IA-GLOBAL saw compat_x red).
recommendation: Record as accepted; include both nodes in the freeze-SHA run.
